title: RSI Pullback Reversion
rationale: Tests whether a simple oversold RSI state captures temporary liquidity-driven pullbacks without inventing new thresholds.
tests_claim: A daily RSI pullback rule improves risk-adjusted behavior by entering after short-term downside pressure.
known_limitations: The current campaign-safe mapping does not expose RSI thresholds as candidate parameters.
Short-term reversal can be turnover-sensitive, so cost sensitivity is critical.
